title: 1936 Prairie's south windows get their arched stone heads
items: In 1904, the windows along the south side of the Thompson-Allerton house at 1936 Prairie Avenue are now round-topped, each framed in a carved brownstone arch, as the house's photograph shows them. They used to be plain square-topped windows.
The two wings on that side are now red brick over the stone basement, like the rest of the house, so their brownstone trim stands out. They used to be all brownstone.
